event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'The future is (also) female II' in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: After the success of this workshop in 2025, Ana Galan and Bonnie Mehring will do a second one. This workshop will have the goal of having a safe space for women* in which we can talk about the current and future challenges to make our communities more inclusive and on how to diversifying Free Software.
Registration is intended for women* and needs registration by 31st October. It is an open space by and for women, and other underrepresented communities.
The workshop will be in English and it will take place in the Crane Hall – Workshop A.
